## Craterhorn (CR 12)

Before you stands what seems to be an enormous bull made entirely of jagged, volcanic stone. Its tail is long and covered in spikes, and its head is devoid of any features, except for a pair of monstrous, beetle-like mandibles.  


**XP** 19,200  
N Huge magical beast  
**Init** +5; **Senses** blindsight 120 ft., tremorsense 300 ft.; Perception +23;  


**Defense**


**AC** 27, touch 9, flat-footed 26 (+1 Dex, +18 natural, –2 size)  
**hp** 212 (17d10+119)  
**Fort** +16, **Ref** +11, **Will** +10  
**DR** 5/—; **Immune** bleed, cold, disease, electricity, fire, paralysis, poison; **SR** 23  
**Weaknesses** blind, vulnerable to sonic  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +25 (3d8+9/19-20), 2 hooves +23 (1d8+4), tail slap +25 (3d6+9/19-20)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** spiked tail, trample (3d8+13, DC 27)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 17th; concentration +18)  


At will—gravel vortex  

3/day—gravity well (DC 16), reverse gravity  

1/day—air walk, cosmic ray (DC 17)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 29, **Dex** 12, **Con** 22, **Int** 3, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 13  
**Base Atk** +17; **CMB** +28; **CMD** 39 (43 vs. trip)  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Critical (bite, tail slap), Iron Will, Multiattack, Weapon Focus (bite, hoof, tail slap), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Perception +23  
**SQ** gravity mastery, no breath  


**Special Abilities**


**Blind (Ex)** A craterhorn sees and senses exclusively through its blindsight and tremorsense abilities. Beyond their range, it is considered blind. A craterhorn is immune to all sight-based effects and attacks, including gaze attacks.  

**Gravity Mastery (Su)** A craterhorn never takes penalties from its gravity effects and can always choose to be affected or unaffected by any gravity effects it is targeted by or in area of.  

**Spiked Tail (Ex)** A craterhorn’s tail spikes allow the creature’s tail slap to deal both bludgeoning and piercing damage. A craterhorn’s tail slap is a primary attack.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or colony (3-8)  
**Treasure** incidental
